title: Fact
description: One displayed fact (spec 10.3): a value, its unit, the whitelisted source it came from, when it was retrieved, and its verification status. The app refuses to render a fact without a passing verification record. See verification/methodology.md.

unit.description: Unit symbol, e.g. "°C", "g/cm³", "u". null when the value has no unit (counts, text, electron configurations).

uncertain.description: True for predicted, estimated or extrapolated values (e.g. superheavy elements). An uncertain value is never a single number: it's a range, or a labelled non-numeric value such as a predicted configuration.

oneOf.description: List of counts, e.g. electrons per shell [2, 8, 1].

range.description: Closed interval. Used for uncertain values, and for values that genuinely vary in nature (e.g. hydrogen's standard atomic weight). min <= max is enforced by the integrity tests, since JSON Schema can't compare fields.

sourceUrl.description: https URL on exactly one of the three whitelisted hosts (spec 5.1). The slash after the host blocks look-alikes such as pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov.example.com and user@host tricks.

retrieved.description: Date the value was retrieved from the source (YYYY-MM-DD).

via.description: The original contributor that the whitelisted page credits for this value, e.g. "IUPAC CIAAW" or "Jefferson Lab". Display only. The citation is still the url.

status.description: Only "pass" may appear in data/verified/. The other values exist for pipeline drafts.

recordId.description: ID of the per-fact record in verification/records/. Unique: no two facts share a record.

derivation.description: Present when the value is calculated from other verified facts rather than read from a page. The rule is implemented in code (app/src/data/derive.ts), and the build recomputes it from the inputs on every run. For a derived fact, source.url points to a page explaining the rule.

inputs.description: recordIds of the input facts, in the order the rule expects.
